## Workload

Marcus Bell completed grading activity during 488 rostered hours. Across that period, he graded 1114 sets, equivalent to 2.3 sets per hour. This workload was reviewed in the context of the scheduled session pattern and the available grading time. The review found that the recorded activity was clearly documented and that the reported throughput was consistent with the hours worked.

## Quality

A sample of 73 sets was read again as part of the quality review. Agreement between the original grading and the subsequent review was 67.1 per cent. The grader and reviewer agreed that the current session pattern should be retained. The review supports continued monitoring of workload and grading consistency through the established review process.

Reviewed by Priya Anand.
